summary: Developer platform with 420M repositories — the social graph of software is deeply entrenched and AI strengthens it.
moat: GitHub's moat is the world's largest corpus of open-source code (over 420 million repositories) combined with the social graph of software development: forks, stars, pull request histories, and contributor reputations built over years. Its CI/CD Actions infrastructure and issue-tracking are embedded in the deployment pipelines of millions of production systems. Migrating these workflows carries massive switching costs for engineering teams.

challengers.name: GitLab and alternative DevOps platforms
challengers.evidence: GitLab offers a fully integrated DevOps platform with its own CI/CD and AI code suggestions, attracting enterprises that prefer to self-host their development infrastructure away from Microsoft-owned GitHub.
